_about: EBA Pillar 3 ESG XBRL element binding for Tellumen's bank prudential disclosure export. To finish: set 'namespace' to the official EBA taxonomy namespace and replace each 'element' null with the official EBA DPM element id/local-name. It binds automatically — services/governance/filing_export.py _load_p3_binding() reads this file; a null element stays honestly provisional, a real namespace + real elements flip the export to the official tags. No code change needed.
_taxonomy: EBA Pillar 3 ESG XBRL taxonomy / DPM — PENDING. The EBA will develop the DPM and XBRL taxonomy for the Pillar 3 Data Hub (P3DH). Only the machine element ids are pending — the template/column references below are those of the governing template specification (data/reference/regspec/bank_p3esg; Template 1 and 5 identical in ITS 2022/2453 and ITS 2024/3172).

TotalBookValue.its_ref: Memo — total gross carrying amount of the book (not a template cell)

PhysicalRiskSensitiveExposure.its_ref: Template 5 — exposures sensitive to physical risk (sum of columns c–f, sector rows 1–9, 13)

PhysicalRiskChronicOnlyExposure.its_ref: Template 5, column h — exposures sensitive to chronic events only (sector rows 1–9, 13)

PhysicalRiskAcuteOnlyExposure.its_ref: Template 5, column i — exposures sensitive to acute events only (sector rows 1–9, 13)

PhysicalRiskChronicAndAcuteExposure.its_ref: Template 5, column j — exposures sensitive to both chronic and acute events (sector rows 1–9, 13)

FinancedEmissionsScope1.its_ref: Memo — Scope 1 part of Template 1 column i (not a separate template column)

FinancedEmissionsScope2.its_ref: Memo — Scope 2 part of Template 1 column i (not a separate template column)

FinancedEmissionsScope3.its_ref: Template 1, column j — of which Scope 3 financed emissions

FinancedEmissionsTotal.its_ref: Template 1, column i, row 56 (TOTAL) — GHG financed emissions, Scope 1, 2 and 3
